story_title: As the assigned Event Coordinator, I want to submit an event for an Operational Safety Check once its venue and technical arrangements are confirmed so that the Safety Officer can review it before the event proceeds

acceptance_criteria.text: Given all of the event's required venue bookings are confirmed and its equipment arrangements are reserved or marked as not required, when the Coordinator views the event, then they can submit it for an Operational Safety Check.

Given a required venue booking or equipment arrangement is still outstanding or flagged for review, when the Coordinator attempts to submit, then submission is refused and the outstanding arrangement is identified.
Submitting changes the event status to Safety Review.
The Safety Review status is visible to the Event Organiser and other users who can view the event's status.
The Safety Officer is notified when an event is submitted for a safety check.
An event cannot be submitted again while a safety check is already pending for it.
Only the assigned Event Coordinator can submit the event for a safety check.
The date and time of submission and who submitted it are recorded against the event.

open_questions: OPEN: AC5 can only be checked on screen once the Safety Officer can log in (SPM-85, Jordan) and the Notifications page is built (SPM-71, Jordan). SPM-86-TC13 is written for it and recorded as Blocked until both are merged. Until then TC01 checks the message that the Safety Officer has been notified, and a unit test checks a notification is saved for every user with the role 'safety_officer' (role key agreed 2026-10-09).

OPEN: AC1's 'marked as not required' can only be tested once SPM-33 (Track Outstanding Arrangements, Kristen) lets the Coordinator mark an arrangement as not required. SPM-86-TC12 is written for it and recorded as Blocked until then; its step 3 names SPM-33's control generically, so update it to SPM-33's wording once built. In code, SPM-33 sets `required: false` in arrangementsFor() (src/lib/eventConfirmation.ts), which checkSafetySubmission() already uses, so submission picks it up with no SPM-86 change - SPM-33 should still add a unit test for it.
RESOLVED 2026-10-09: Equipment that is Partially fulfilled counts as arranged for submission, the same as for Confirm event (SPM-34), so the two never disagree (TC05).

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: The 'Submit for safety check' button is shown to the assigned Coordinator whenever the event is in Planning, as the 'Confirm event' button is. Whether the arrangements are ready is checked on submit, and a refusal names what is outstanding (TC06-TC08).

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: Besides the Safety Officer's decision (SPM-87) and a significant edit (SPM-88) returning it to Planning, an event in Safety review may only be cancelled. There is no Cancel action in the app yet (SPM-37), so this is a lifecycle rule covered by a unit test, not a manual case. SPM-37's owner has been told.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: A flagged venue booking or flagged equipment request (VenueBooking.needsReview from SPM-39/SPM-62, EquipmentRequest.needsReview from SPM-62) blocks submission and is named with its reason (TC07, TC08). Showing a 'Flagged' badge on the Venue and Equipment tabs is left to Review Flagged Arrangements (SPM-68).

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: AC8 is shown as a 'Safety check' row under 'Status' in the Overview's 'Details' card, to internal users only; the Event Organiser sees the 'Safety review' status but not who submitted it (TC02, TC03), in line with SPM-88 keeping safety details internal.

DECIDED 2026-10-09: Wording - button 'Submit for safety check'; dialog title 'Submit for safety check?' with a 'Submit' button; success 'The event has been submitted for a safety check. The Safety Officer has been notified.'; refusal 'This event cannot be submitted for a safety check yet: ...' followed by the same reasons Confirm event gives, plus '... is flagged for review (<reason>)' for flagged items; already pending 'A safety check is already pending for this event.'; Details row 'Safety check' = 'Awaiting review · submitted by <name>, <date and time>'.

DECIDED 2026-10-09: New status label 'Safety review' (lower_snake 'safety_review'). It is added to the organiser's and coordinator's Dashboard as a 'Safety review' section after 'Planning', to the Venue Staff and Technical Support 'Upcoming events' lists, to the All Events status filter, and to the statuses in which Technical Support can see an event's equipment and the Ops Manager can reassign its coordinator.

DECIDED 2026-10-09: Who and when is stored in a new SafetyCheck record (one per submission: event, status 'pending', submitted by, submitted at) and in the event's status history (Planning -> Safety review). SPM-87 adds the decision to the same record.
